name: Emily
source: The team's medic and researcher. She's tasked with finding a new way of defeating vampires and patching up the team after their fights. Emily is very outgoing and doesn't shy away from flirting, even if she's just met you. If you don't put up a resis- tance, she'll swallow you whole.
